text: APPROVE. The extracted `StepInQuote` and `IsShebang` keep the original logic exactly (backslash skips the next char, closing quote resets, `#!` returns -1), and removing the nested `if`/`else if` blocks and the `&&` chain from `CommentStart` should drop its cognitive complexity well below 15. Nothing in the diff looks likely to trigger a warning-as-error. I reviewed the diff only and did not build it or run the tests.
